description: Source code for the Bitmap class managing a bit array, including bit manipulation methods such as set, get, toggle, resize, and range testing within the disk_cache namespace.

classes.name: Bitmap
classes.description: A class representing a bitmap with methods for bit manipulation, resizing, and range testing.

methods.name: FindLSBNonEmpty
methods.description: Finds the index of the least significant bit set to |value| in a 32-bit word.

methods.name: Resize
methods.description: Resizes the bitmap to a new number of bits, optionally clearing new bits.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets the bit at a specified index to true or false.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Returns the value of the bit at a specified index.

methods.name: Toggle
methods.description: Inverts the bit at a specified index.

methods.name: SetMapElement
methods.description: Sets a specific element of the internal map array.

methods.name: GetMapElement
methods.description: Retrieves a specific element of the internal map array.

methods.name: SetMap
methods.description: Copies an external map array into the internal map.

methods.name: SetRange
methods.description: Sets a range of bits to a specified value.

methods.name: TestRange
methods.description: Tests if any bit in a range matches a specified value.

methods.name: FindNextBit
methods.description: Finds the next bit set to |value| starting from a given index.

methods.name: FindBits
methods.description: Finds a contiguous run of bits with the same value starting from an index.

methods.name: SetWordBits
methods.description: Sets a number of bits within a single word to a specified value.
